name: Formula 1 Shake - Vanilla
description: Formula 1 Shake Vanilla is a delicious, nutrient-dense meal replacement shake packed with 18g of high-quality protein per serving. Perfect for weight management, muscle support, and daily nutrition. Made with soy protein, vitamins, and minerals to fuel your active lifestyle.
ingredients: Soy Protein Isolate, Fructose, Cocoa, Vitamins (A, C, D, E, B-complex), Minerals (Calcium, Iron, Zinc), Natural Vanilla Flavor
usage: Mix 2 scoops (26g) with 250ml of skimmed milk or water. Shake well. Consume as a meal replacement or post-workout recovery drink. 1-2 servings per day.

name: Formula 1 - Berry Burst
description: Formula 1 Berry Burst is a refreshing berry-flavored meal replacement shake with 18g of protein per serving. Rich in antioxidants from real berry extracts, this shake supports your fitness goals while satisfying your taste buds. Ideal for weight loss and muscle toning.
ingredients: Soy Protein Isolate, Berry Blend (Strawberry, Blueberry, Raspberry), Vitamins (A, C, D, E, B-complex), Minerals, Natural Berry Flavor
usage: Mix 2 scoops (26g) with 250ml of skimmed milk or water. Shake well. Consume as breakfast or post-workout. 1-2 servings per day.

name: Herbal Tea Concentrate - Peach
description: Herbal Tea Concentrate Peach is a refreshing, zero-sugar herbal tea blend infused with peach flavor. Packed with natural antioxidants and metabolism-boosting herbs. Perfect for daily hydration, detox, and weight management support. No artificial sweeteners.
ingredients: Green Tea Extract, Peach Extract, Garcinia Cambogia, Chromium, Natural Herbs (Ginger, Turmeric), Stevia (natural sweetener)
usage: Mix 1 tablespoon (15ml) in 200ml hot or cold water. Stir well. Consume 2-3 times daily, preferably before meals.

name: Protein Drink Mix - Vanilla
description: Protein Drink Mix Vanilla is a high-protein formula designed for muscle recovery and growth. With 24g of protein per serving, it supports muscle synthesis, reduces recovery time, and helps build lean mass. Ideal for athletes and fitness enthusiasts.
ingredients: Whey Protein Concentrate, Whey Protein Isolate, BCAAs (Leucine, Isoleucine, Valine), Creatine, Natural Vanilla Flavor, Sucralose
usage: Mix 1 scoop (33g) with 200-250ml water or milk. Shake well. Consume within 30 minutes post-workout for best results. 1 serving per day.
